lane.description: Cooper-Cowan Multi-Altitude Theta-Map / Hyperbolic-Tilt Edge Invariants + DOE GDR-1391 Chemical Geothermometer Disequilibrium Upflow Plumes + Prior-Shift-Calibrated Subsurface Auto-Context

hypothesis: Multi-altitude Cooper-Cowan Theta-Map and Hyperbolic-Tilt edge invariants across upward-continued RTP magnetics (B02) and isostatic gravity (B13), combined with anisotropic chemical geothermometer disequilibrium (Delta_T_eq) upflow plumes (GDR-1391) and prior-shift-calibrated subsurface auto-context (B12/B19-blind), recover concealed geothermal and intra-basin fault segments without duplicating DEM scarp lattices.
mechanism: 1) Poisson upward continuation at z=200m, 600m, 1500m with Cooper-Cowan cos(theta) and hyperbolic tilt + cross-altitude dip migration; 2) GDR-1391 silica/cation geothermometer disequilibrium excess diffused along B02+B13+B15 structure-tensor strike (<=1.2 km, regional >=3 km bowls subtracted per IR-91-S15-07); 3) B15-deconfounded B17 smectite-cap x B02 magnetite-destruction trough; 4) Prior-shift calibration (prior_shift_calibrate_surface) applied to all 6 pairwise 2-quadrant and 4 OOF 3-quadrant Stage-1 splits before stitching local auto-context (IR-91-S15-06).
named_non_fault_mimic_process: Evaporitic playa brines (high B17 conductivity), reversed-polarity Tertiary volcanic flow margins (local B02 troughs), and GeoDAWN flight-line leveling seams.

final_dots.dot_overlap_policy: strict directed candidate-within-3px-of-registry for every registry raster

literal_all_reference_capacity_bound.calculation: At most one binary dot per uncovered cell; overlap >= (budget - uncovered_cells)/budget. Spacing can only tighten this bound.
literal_all_reference_capacity_bound.policy: No reference removed or threshold changed. A source-feed inventory is not universal raster uniqueness.

final.reason: Passes all 40+ real registry & download rasters (max 3-px dot overlap = 0.5606 <= 0.70, max |rho| = 0.08657 <= 0.90), but under the literal frozen 89-file inventory including the 206,895-dot synthetic whole-Nevada lattice calib_r13lattice_00904.tif, any 37,654-dot candidate has overlap >= 82.34% > 70% (docs/s16/registry-feasibility.json).
